outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with raw western blot images (not a plot of averaged data); no averaging is depicted, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows bar charts of western blot densitometry (% FT depletion, log2 elution abundance) per antibody. There are no error bars and the caption/methods indicate a single western blot evaluation per antibody rather than an average across replicates, so there is no underlying replicate distribution that individual points would need to represent.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot showing the full distribution of log2 enrichment ratios; violin plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as they already display the data distribution.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean ± SD (n = 4) MS abundance per antibody, and individual data points (open circles) are overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F is a sequence alignment plus a molecular/protein structure rendering, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
Panel G is a scatterplot comparing enrichment ratios across conditions; scatterplots inherently show individual data points and are exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatterplot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance across individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt as individual points are the data itself.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point already represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
Panel J consists of PCA scatterplots (per tissue) where each point already represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
